cases.description: Two consecutive calls to JsonSchemaFactory.builder() must return distinct Builder objects (different references).
Invoking build() on the Builder returned by JsonSchemaFactory.builder() should yield a non‑null JsonSchemaFactory.

Configure one Builder (e.g., set a custom SchemaValidatorsConfig via its API), build a factory, then create a second Builder without that configuration and build another factory. The two factories must be distinct and the second must not inherit the custom configuration of the first.
Calling JsonSchemaFactory.builder(null) should behave like the no‑arg overload and return a fresh, non‑null Builder object rather than throwing an exception.
